author: Amiros12
quote:
After 13 years of waiting, GTA 6 is a complete disaster.
The game is full of bugs. Constant crashes, characters falling through the map, cars spawning inside buildings, mission-breaking glitches, and NPCs getting stuck in walls every five minutes. Performance is terrible too — locked 30fps with heavy stuttering and long loading times. It feels unfinished and rushed.
On top of that, the game is extremely woke. Forced diversity everywhere, awkward progressive messaging shoved into the story, and characters that feel more like political checkboxes than actual people. Rockstar used to make sharp satire. Now it feels like they’re more worried about not offending the wrong people than making a fun, edgy game.
Lucia and Jason are boring, the story is weak, and the open world loses its charm fast once the technical problems and forced messaging kick in. Missions are still the same repetitive formula, just with more bugs and more lectures.
Overhyped, buggy, and ruined by woke politics. GTA V is still better. Avoid until they fix the mess and tone down the agenda. I only give one because old games memories not zero

author: Amiros12
quote: Cyberpunk 2077 is a decent game, but nothing extraordinary in my opinion. The gameplay is enjoyable, the combat is fun, and Night City looks incredible. However, the story and overall experience don't always live up to the hype. Not a bad game, not a masterpiece either. Just a good game with solid gameplay.

author: Amiros12
quote: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is what gaming should be. An incredible story, unforgettable characters, breathtaking music, beautiful art direction, and meaningful themes without forcing unnecessary political agendas. This game proves that you can create something diverse, emotional, and artistic without sacrificing quality or turning everything into a political statement. A true masterpiece. 10/10. One of the best RPGs in years.

author: Amiros12
quote: Honestly, Ghost of Yōtei was a disappointment. It feels like a step backward rather than a true evolution of Ghost of Tsushima. The story lacks the emotional depth and impact of the original, and the overall experience doesn't feel nearly as memorable. I expected much more from **** Punch. Definitely not worth all the hype..
